Name: 4 Player Coop Greenhouse
Author: zukane2
Description:
A simple greenhouse for 4 player coop. You and your friend can now have 4 separate plot inside the greenhouse to plant different crops and trees.

Compatible with upgraded Iridium Sprinkler with Pressure Nozzle

Requires latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]
Requires latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]

How to install the mod:
1. Download the mod
2. Open the zip file
3. Extract it to Stardew Valley/Mods.

To uninstall the mod you just have to delete "[CP] 4 Player Coop Greenhouse" folder from Stardew Valley/Mods.

Warning: If you currently have crops on your greenhouse you might want to harvest and pick up everything before installing this mod.
